attributes.name: bp-layout
attributes.description: Declarative layout utility. Applies block, inline, or grid layouts with gap, alignment, responsive column/row controls, and margin spacing to any element.

tokenGroups.name: type
tokenGroups.description: The layout mode. Exactly one is required per element.

values.description: CSS Grid with 12-column system and container queries

tokenGroups.name: gap
tokenGroups.description: Space between child items. Uses t-shirt sizing mapped to design tokens.

tokenGroups.name: alignment
tokenGroups.description: Container-level alignment of children along block (vertical) and inline (horizontal) axes.

values.description: Align children to inline start (left in LTR)
Align children to inline end (right in LTR)

tokenGroups.name: columns-implicit
tokenGroups.description: Uniform column span applied to all grid children. Only valid with grid layout type.

tokenGroups.name: columns-explicit
tokenGroups.description: Explicit column span on an individual child element. Only valid on children of a grid.

tokenGroups.name: column-position
tokenGroups.description: Grid column start/end positions for explicit placement. Only valid on children of a grid.

tokenGroups.name: rows-implicit
tokenGroups.description: Uniform row span applied to all grid children. Only valid with grid layout type.

tokenGroups.name: rows-explicit
tokenGroups.description: Explicit row span on an individual child element. Only valid on children of a grid.

tokenGroups.name: row-position
tokenGroups.description: Grid row start/end positions for explicit placement. Only valid on children of a grid.

tokenGroups.name: margin
tokenGroups.description: Margin spacing utilities using t-shirt sizing.

attributes.name: bp-text
attributes.description: Typography utility. Applies semantic text styles, alignment, transforms, and sizing to any element. Features automatic contrast adjustment and responsive fluid scaling.

tokenGroups.name: type
tokenGroups.description: Semantic text scale. Sets font-size, font-weight, and line-height. Headings use balanced text wrapping.

tokenGroups.name: style
tokenGroups.description: Text style modifiers that can be combined with any type.

values.description: Inline monospace with subtle background. Inherits surrounding text flow.
Block-level monospace with background, padding, border, and shadow. Use with <pre>.
Link styling with underline. Inherits parent font-size and weight.
Vertical list layout with consistent gap. Apply to <ul> or <ol>.
Align text to start (left in LTR)
Align text to end (right in LTR)

tokenGroups.name: transform
tokenGroups.description: CSS text-transform applied to the element.

values.description: Capitalize first letter of each word

tokenGroups.name: size
tokenGroups.description: Responsive size scaling modifier. Overrides default fluid scaling behavior.

values.description: Disable fluid/responsive scaling, use fixed size
Scale text to fill container width (max scale 100)
Disable automatic contrast adjustment for colored backgrounds
